callouts.id: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题#2
callouts.title: 想法
callouts.body:
如果一个和，看起来像一个黎曼和，那么我们只要找到其对应的函数，并用黎曼积分去近似它就好了。

这里之所以说看起来像，而不是说本身就是一个黎曼和，是因为有时候，虽然一个和并不能算作是某个函数的黎曼和，但是误差并不超过问题要求的精度，那么我们可以配合利用[[利用已知的渐近结果求渐近展开的技巧]]同样达到目的。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Approximate a sum by a Riemann sum
if_strategy_template.summary_en: If a sum resembles a Riemann sum, identify the corresponding function and approximate the sum by a Riemann integral. Even if it is not exactly a Riemann sum, the method still works when the discrepancy is within the required error tolerance.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a discrete sum has scaled terms and indexing that approximate area or volume elements, especially in asymptotic limit problems.

callouts.id: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题#3
callouts.title: 问题2
callouts.body: $$S_n:=\sum_{i\leq n}\sum_{j\leq 2n}\frac{2}{n^2}\left\lfloor\frac{2i+j}{n}\right\rfloor$$这个和，在$o(1)$的精度范围内，是否可以看成是一个黎曼和?

classification_result.id: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题#3

if_problem.statement_en: For $$S_n:=\sum_{i\leq n}\sum_{j\leq 2n}\frac{2}{n^2}\left\lfloor\frac{2i+j}{n}\right\rfloor,$$ can this sum, up to an error of order $o(1)$, be regarded as a Riemann sum?

callouts.id: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题#4
callouts.title: 想法
callouts.body: 我们只要能在误差为$o(n^2)$的范围内估算出$h$这个函数的每个取值的在集合$\{1,\cdots,n\}\times\{1,\cdots,2n\}$当中的原像的元素的个数，那么我们就能得到$S_n$的极限。即我们需要搞清楚下面这个四边形图形内部及其边界上的整数格点的数目，误差范围在$o(n^2)$级别:$$\{(x,y)\in \{1,...,n\}\times\{1,...,2n\}:kn\leq  2x+y < (k+1)n\}$$其中$k=0,1,2,3$

classification_result.id: 整数格点与一个带取整函数的和的极限问题#4

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Reduce the sum to counting lattice points in level sets
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Group terms according to the value of the floor function and estimate how many integer lattice points map to each value. An error of order $o(n^2)$ in these counts is sufficient to determine the limit of the normalized sum.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a sum contains a floor function or piecewise-constant expression whose values are determined by linear inequalities over integer grids.
